title: Favorite trumpeters: Kid Rena, Kid Howard, Elmer Talbot
summary: He names his favorite trumpet players and describes Kid Rena's strong tone and chops.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: If you had to make a choice in picking a trumpet player or a cornet, who would be your favorite on that if you ever heard?
You mean back time, years ago?
Oh, any time or years ago?

Well, I got, see I got, today I like Mike on trumpet, Mike DeLay. Yeah, he is very good. I like Mike DeLay on trumpet very much. And now back further, I think the kid was great. Kid Renee. Kid Renee, yeah, I think he was great. And another boy is very good too. He's nice, he had a kind of stroke now, but he's always, he was always, well with me, I mean for his playing is concerned, it was Kid Howard. Oh, Kid Howard. And another guy I like, he was kind of weak, but I liked him too. It was Elmer Talbot called Cuckoo. He's a good one too. But he was a little weak cause he had had a slight stroke. Yeah. But he's pretty good.
How did Kid Renee play? Did he play low or high or?
At times, yeah, at times. He played low, sometimes high.
Did he have a big powerful tone? Was he?
Very, very strong. Very strong. He had lots of chops. Yeah, he had good chops. Very good chops. Kid had very good chops.
